blocks.text: American actress-singer Dove Cameron and Damiano David, frontman of rock band Måneskin, have tied the knot in Italy after about three years of dating. Cameron and David exchanged I dos in Montalcino, Tuscany, on Thursday, Sept. 24, as confirmed by PEOPLE. The pair donned matching suits in shades of white. The ceremony, held at a historic town hall, was attended by the couple’s friends and loved ones. Cameron and David were first romantically linked in September 2023 after the former was spotted at one of the singer’s concerts in New York.
